title: Grateful Dead Live at P.N.E. Garden Auditorium on 1966-07-29

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard recording of a classic July 29 1966 set, highlighted by an outstanding Cream Puff War and early Garcia brilliance.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers crisp, well‑balanced sound that showcases the band’s raw 1966 energy – listeners rave about the superb mix and Pigpen’s organ on the early psychedelic numbers.  The performance shines especially on “Cream Puff War,” which reviewers call the best version they’ve heard, though a couple of post‑show filler tracks from a later broadcast are noted.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 4–5) and enthusiastic comments about both the music and the mix indicate a strong show with excellent soundboard quality, only offset by minor filler‑track issues.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Great clarity and balanced mix throughout; some reviewers note that the last two tracks are unrelated filler from a later broadcast.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid early‑psychedelic pop set with classic 1966 vibe; the band builds energy steadily and the audience’s muted response adds to the authentic feel.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Early Garcia brilliance praised, especially his guitar tone on the Cream Puff War.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's organ is highlighted as sounding great throughout the performance.
